integrity: The published paper supplies the exact automorphism-group reduct chain; independent finite generation of labeled plane-rooted, rooted, and unrooted binary trees checks the enumerative layer and both uniform fiber sizes.
scientific_limitations: The tree correspondences and Catalan/double-factorial enumerations are classical; originality is claimed only for the exact integrated orbit tower of the M3<M4<M6 hypergraph chain and its uniform collapse laws.
The proof relies on the published definability identifications of the three hypergraph automorphism groups.
Older oligomorphic/Jordan-group literature creates a residual folklore risk for equivalent individual orbit formulas.
title: Exact Catalan–double-factorial orbit tower for M3 < M4 < M6
